item.title: Sand Hollow State Park installs new buoys to protect swimmers
item.description: Sand Hollow State Park has installed a new buoy barrier to keep motorized vessels out of recreational areas where swimmers frequent.

item.title: Honduran national accused of kidnapping, rape of 13-year-old girl in West Valley City
item.description: A Honduran national has been arrested and charged with the kidnapping and rape of a 13-year-old girl in West Valley City. Documents say his actions were "sadistic and cruel."

item.title: You might see smoke around Zion National Park this week because of prescribed burn
item.description: Zion National Park's fire management team burned a fuel pile Monday afternoon and warned that locals and visitors may see smoke for the next few days.

item.title: 'Squatty Potty' creator federally indicted for purchasing child sexual abuse material
item.description: The Utah man who created the "Squatty Potty" has been federally indicted for purchasing child sexual abuse material (CSAM).

item.title: Lower income seniors in Salt Lake County have worse health, report says
item.description: According to a recent study commissioned by Salt Lake County, nearly one-third of low-income older adults in the area report poor physical health.

item.title: State looks to move redistricting, abortion, two environmental cases to three-judge panel under new law
item.description: Four high-profile cases against the state could be moved from their current district judge to newly created three-judge panels, according to court filings in each case.

item.title: Brigham City man sentenced to prison for sexually abusing his child, possessing CSAM
item.description: A Brigham City man who police say sexually abused his child and used AI to generate child sexual abuse material (CSAM) has been sentenced to prison.

item.title: Police respond to shots fired on 9000 S in Sandy
item.description: Police are looking for a suspect who they say fired multiple shots at another vehicle in Sandy.

item.title: Utah 2034: Building the roadmap to another legacy
item.description: The 2026 Winter Games in Milan Cortina did not disappoint!

item.title: Temporary boat ramp in the works to maintain access to Cataract Canyon at Lake Powell
item.description: After record-low water levels at Lake Powell, officials are working to create a temporary boat ramp to maintain water access to Cataract Canyon.
